verdict.rationale: Firebase Security Rules are a first-party, well-documented mechanism to restrict data access per user across Firestore, Realtime Database, and Cloud Storage, and community discussion confirms real-world usage (including separating auth logic from data logic and testing rules via the emulator suite). Missing for 10: independent quantitative benchmark of rule complexity/limitations and explicit per-row (document-level) example syntax in the evidence, and community notes some friction (rule preprocessors, difficulty porting rules) rather than flawless praise.
